about: Christmas Race Board (Henry, Nov 2026): Race Board's rules and code (games/race-board/app.js) with a Christmas question bank, Challenge squares and Forfeit cards. 189 Christmas questions (Nov 18; 11 rebus cut in Henry's audit) for every level, each with an id: 92 trivia, 22 rebus puzzles (rebus = lines shown big), 33 brain teasers, 17 reindeer math, 25 Christmas science; 59 easy, 56 regular, 45 hard, 29 impossible, drawn in those proportions (shares). The answer is an index for A-D questions, text for spoken ones. Asked questions are remembered on the phone (Kru.saveKeep) so later groups get new ones until every question has been asked. Math and science questions have a cat for the math-or-science chance card. christmas.squares = the Challenge squares; challenge and forfeit = the two card decks (20 each).

forfeit.title: Christmas Morning
forfeit.text: Your whole team must create a frozen statue showing Christmas morning.

forfeit.title: Reindeer Jumps
forfeit.text: Do 10 jumping jacks while counting out loud.

forfeit.title: Santa Squats
forfeit.text: Do 10 squats. Say "Ho!" every time you go down.

forfeit.title: Elf Balance
forfeit.text: Stand on one foot with your arms out for 10 seconds.

forfeit.title: Late for the Sleigh
forfeit.text: Run on the spot as fast as you can for 10 seconds.

forfeit.title: Snowman Plank
forfeit.text: Hold a plank on the floor for 10 seconds.

forfeit.title: Touch the Snow
forfeit.text: Touch your toes, then reach for the sky. Do it 5 times!

forfeit.title: Rudolph Hops
forfeit.text: Hop on one foot 10 times. Then switch feet!

intro.title: Christmas Dash!
text: Every team has a piece on START.
First team to land exactly on FINISH wins!

intro.title: Your turn
text: Answer one question. Harder questions = more dice!
Wrong? Roll the same dice backwards, or take a Forfeit.

intro.title: Power-ups
text: Each team can use each power-up ONCE per game.
50/50, +20 seconds, Free Play, or Risk it!

intro.title: Special squares
text: ★ forward · ⚠ back · 🎲 roll again · ? chance · 🎄 challenge.

intro.title: Challenges and forfeits
text: 🎄 square: draw a Challenge card and do it together!
Wrong answer? Do a Forfeit and stay put, or roll back.

intro.title: Exact finish
text: You need the exact number to land on FINISH.
Too many? Bounce back the extra squares.
